dataset.title: Application library
dataset.description: Applications TEAL platforms are configured for, each with process, material, recommended source/power and the engineering rationale.

records.name: Metals — general traceability
records.description: Steel, SS, Al, brass, Ti, Ni alloys
records.rationale: Steels absorb 1064 nm gratefully. Annealing gives corrosion-safe marks for medical and food contact.

records.name: Anodised Al / colour
records.description: Black on anodised, colour on SS/Ti
records.rationale: MOPA pulse control produces deep blacks on anodised aluminium without breaching the anodic layer.

records.name: Deep engraving
records.description: Tooling, dies, VIN and plate marking
records.rationale: Higher average power and multi-pass strategies drive depth; 100 W is the productive engraving point.

records.name: Engineering plastics
records.rationale: Polymer response is grade- and additive-dependent; TEAL validates against your actual resin.

records.name: Medical annealing
records.rationale: Anneal marks leave the passive layer intact — the regime for corrosion-critical medical marking.

records.name: Colour marking on SS / Ti
records.rationale: Tunable pulse duration controls oxide thickness — the mechanism behind repeatable colour on stainless and titanium.

records.name: Black on anodised Al
records.rationale: Low-fluence, high-frequency MOPA parameter sets mark within the anodic layer without cracking it.

records.name: Thin foils & films
records.rationale: Short pulses limit heat penetration — the requirement on foils, plated layers and battery tabs.

records.name: Heat-sensitive plastics
records.rationale: Pulse tailoring produces contrast by foaming or carbonising selectively, without melt distortion.

records.name: Dual-side board ID
records.rationale: CO₂ at 10.6 µm ablates solder mask with high contrast without attacking the copper beneath — the industry-standard chemistry for PCB identity.

records.name: Panel & depanel marks
records.rationale: Panel maps with multi-board step-and-repeat; X-out logic suppresses marks on rejected boards.

records.name: White / specialty mask
records.rationale: 9.3 µm is absorbed more strongly by some mask formulations, recovering contrast where 10.6 µm reads flat.

records.name: Micro DMC on rigid & flex
records.rationale: At 355 nm the mark forms by photochemical reaction rather than heat — fine, high-contrast codes with negligible thermal input.

records.name: Flex circuit & coverlay
records.rationale: Flex and coverlay delaminate under thermal marking; UV keeps the substrate intact.

records.name: Component-level marking
records.rationale: Low pulse energy allows marking on populated boards without risk to adjacent devices.

records.name: Medical polymer UDI
records.rationale: UV marking is validated for medical polymers where carbonisation is not acceptable.

records.name: Marking-on-the-fly
records.rationale: Queue-tracking handles multiple parts in field simultaneously; the beam chases the product rather than stopping it.

records.name: Indexed conveyor marking
records.rationale: Indexed presentation gives the tightest placement accuracy where takt allows a brief dwell.

records.name: Rotary-dial multi-station
records.rationale: Overlapping load and process on a dial collapses effective cycle time to the longest single station.

records.name: Cell & can marking
records.rationale: MOPA parameter sets deliver dark codes on aluminium and nickel-plated steel with negligible heat into the cell.

records.name: Micro spot welds
records.rationale: Shaped millisecond pulses put energy where resistance welding cannot reach, without electrode wear drift.

records.name: Continuous & stitch seams
records.rationale: CW single-mode with wobble gives continuous seams with controlled heat input on thin sections.

records.name: Wire-to-pad & terminals
records.rationale: Fine spots and per-weld energy monitoring make structural joints out of what used to be soldering.

records.name: Repair & tool welding
records.rationale: Localised deposition with minimal HAZ preserves surrounding tool geometry and hardness.

records.name: Cell tab-to-terminal
records.rationale: Green at 532 nm is strongly absorbed by copper, stabilising the melt where 1 µm reflects and stutters.

records.name: Module & pack busbars
records.rationale: Ring-mode beam shaping plus wobble keeps the keyhole stable through thick section, suppressing spatter.

records.name: Hairpin stator pairs
records.rationale: Tight, repeatable joints at rate; monitoring turns each weld into inspectable data for the traction warranty.

records.name: Cell can & lid seaming
records.rationale: Controlled heat input avoids damaging cell internals while achieving a continuous sealed seam.

records.name: 3D continuous & stitch seams
records.rationale: When the seam moves in three dimensions the beam should follow, not the part — remote optics on six axes.

records.name: Corner & lap joints
records.rationale: Low distortion versus TIG/MIG removes most post-weld straightening and finishing cost.

records.name: E-drive components
records.rationale: Cycle-repeatable robotic paths replace scarce skilled welders on cosmetic and structural seams.

records.name: TO-can & butterfly sealing
records.rationale: Ramp-shaped pulses seal without cracking glass-to-metal feedthroughs or disturbing internal optics.

records.name: Implant enclosure seams
records.rationale: Overlap-controlled seam generation with per-pulse energy logging produces the evidence a regulator expects.

records.name: Sensor & MEMS packages
records.rationale: Fine spots and inert shielding hold vacuum integrity through the life of the device.

records.name: Feedthrough & bellows
records.rationale: Circumferential seams on runout-compensating chucks keep penetration uniform around the joint.

records.name: Rust & oxide removal
records.rationale: Pulsed ablation is self-limiting — oxide leaves, base metal stays. No media, no disposal stream.

records.name: Weld preparation
records.rationale: Clean joint faces immediately before welding, at the fixture, without moving the assembly.

records.name: Mould & die touch-up
records.rationale: Low average power lifts residue without dimensional attack on the tool surface.

records.name: Paint & coating removal
records.rationale: Layer-by-layer removal with controlled fluence, stopping at the substrate.

records.name: Pre-weld / pre-bond prep
records.rationale: Path-programmed optics deliver identical energy to the same area every cycle — cleanliness becomes an auditable parameter.

records.name: Mould & tool cleaning
records.rationale: Replaces dry-ice and solvent cycles whose cost scales linearly with volume.

records.name: Battery cell & tray
records.rationale: Dry, particulate-managed cleaning compatible with the electrode-area environment.

records.name: Selective coating removal
records.rationale: Robot paths give sharp boundaries where masking would otherwise be required.

records.name: Battery electrode & foil
records.rationale: Tool-free geometry with no burr and no mechanical slitting stress on the electrode edge.

records.name: Flexible PCB singulation
records.rationale: UV avoids the delamination and carbonisation that IR produces on polyimide stacks.

records.name: Film, gasket & kiss-cut
records.rationale: Die and punch tooling cost and lead time disappear; geometry changes are a CAD edit.

records.name: HAZ-critical micro cuts
records.rationale: Picosecond pulses interact before heat diffuses — the cleanest edges on the most sensitive materials.

records.name: Thin metal profiles
records.description: SS, Al, brass shim and sheet
records.rationale: Precision guides and capacitive height sensing deliver thin-gauge edge quality plate cutters cannot.

records.name: Engineering plastics
records.rationale: CO₂ is efficiently absorbed by organics that ignore 1064 nm — one table serves both material worlds.

records.name: Glass scribe-and-break
records.rationale: Scribe modes turn brittleness into an asset, avoiding the chipping of mechanical dicing.

records.name: Alumina / AlN scribing
records.rationale: Controlled-depth grooves give clean snap lines on technical ceramic substrates.

records.name: Front-side scribe ID
records.rationale: Font geometry, dot morphology and depth are tuned per film stack against your OCR readers, then locked in recipe.

records.name: Back-side ID post-grind
records.rationale: Marks placed and profiled so downstream readers still resolve them after thinning and film deposition.

records.name: 2D wafer codes
records.rationale: Machine-readable codes to SEMI convention keep foundry and OSAT interoperability intact.

records.name: High-reflectivity films
records.rationale: Green couples into reflective films where UV or IR scatter, holding mark consistency across the stack.

records.name: Mould-compound marking
records.rationale: Contrast on epoxy mould compound with grading correlated to your reader optics — readability engineered, not hoped for.

records.name: Per-unit DMC serialisation
records.rationale: Every unit posts identity to the host with map correlation, so test and tape-and-reel inherit clean data.

records.name: Substrate & strip ID
records.rationale: Green gives contrast on substrates where IR marks read weak or damage the surface finish.

records.name: Fine-pitch micro codes
records.rationale: UV holds cell definition at code sizes where thermal marking blurs the module boundary.

records.name: Alumina substrate scribing
records.rationale: Controlled-depth grooving gives predictable break lines without micro-cracking the ceramic.

records.name: AlN scribing
records.rationale: AlN demands tighter depth control than alumina; parameters are established per supplier lot.

records.name: Glass scribing
records.rationale: Ultrashort pulses scribe glass with chip-free edges where nanosecond regimes fracture.

records.name: Failure-analysis decap
records.rationale: Dry, controlled removal opens the cavity without the bond-wire attack and handling burden of pure acid decap.

records.name: Wire-safe window opening
records.rationale: Layer-by-layer ablation with camera process view stops short of the wire loop plane.

records.name: Cylindrical can marking
records.rationale: MOPA delivers dark, high-contrast codes on aluminium and nickel-plated steel with negligible heat into the cell.

records.name: Prismatic housing
records.rationale: Flat presentation allows larger codes and in-line grading before the cell enters formation.

records.name: Pouch material marking
records.rationale: Low fluence marks the laminate without compromising the barrier layer.

records.name: Genealogy aggregation
records.rationale: One record per unit tying weld scores, mark grades and parameters together — the record your recall team will need.

records.name: End-of-line traceability
records.rationale: Final identity applied and verified, closing the data chain before dispatch.

records.name: Multi-process cell
records.description: Clean, mark, verify in one dial
records.rationale: Sequential stations around the dial collapse several operations into one takt and one fixture datum.

records.name: High-rate single process
records.rationale: Overlapping load with process makes effective cycle equal to the longest station, not their sum.

records.name: Inline integration
records.rationale: Products flow through multiple processes without leaving the pallet datum, so accuracy compounds rather than degrades.

records.name: High-mix production
records.rationale: Bypass lanes and buffers absorb model changes without stopping the upstream line.

records.name: Complex 3D geometry
records.description: Parts a fixed optic cannot reach
records.rationale: Six axes present the part or carry the head wherever the feature sits, without bespoke fixturing per variant.

records.name: Multi-machine tending
records.rationale: Tool changers let a single cell cover marking, cleaning and inspection on a shared takt.

records.name: Collaborative loading
records.rationale: Force-limited handling suits light parts and frequent redeployment without full guarding.
